Elena / team — adding the capacity & SLO side. Quick notes from infra: 

1) Reserved capacity: we'll provision a Dedicated pool with an initial commit for week 0–12. Expect baseline throughput of 120 req/s (p95 < 350ms) for the pilot canary.
2) Canary cadence (recommended):
   - Week 2: 2% traffic — 72h monitoring window (trace + token-cost checks).
   - Week 3: 10% traffic — 72h monitoring + model-quality evals on your sample prompts.
   - Week 4: 50% traffic — 48h monitoring; begin gradual migration of non-critical endpoints.
   - Week 5: 100% traffic — final cut once acceptance gates pass.
3) Rollback triggers: sustained token error rate >1.5%, mean latency spike >40% over baseline for 30+ minutes, or automated eval quality regression (F1 drop >4 pts).
4) Migration window: we propose a 2-hour maintenance window during off-peak (Sun 02:00–04:00 PT) for the primary data transfer and KV cache pre-warm. If Olive prefers local cut windows, we can adapt.

I attached a short spreadsheet with the capacity commit and expected costs for the pilot phase (already included in redwood_activation_manifest_v1.xlsx).

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
